front.title: Hands-On With Apple's New OLED Touchscreen MacBook Pro
front.tldr: Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro, with a PROLED OLED display, has reached customers. Early hands-on impressions from MacRumors focus on the screen and what touch finally adds to the Mac.

front.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
front.tldr: OpenAI is reported to have raised a further $11 billion, in a round that has not yet closed, valuing the company at $1.25 trillion.

front.title: The New York Times reportedly in talks to buy Letterboxd for $330 million
front.tldr: Letterboxd, the social app beloved by film fans, is reportedly in talks to be bought by The New York Times for $330 million. The platform has grown fast in recent years.

stories.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
stories.tldr: Meta has introduced Spaces, a new way to collaborate with its Muse AI agents, the latest in a steady stream of updates to the assistant.

stories.title: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo
stories.tldr: Startup Underdog has demoed a speech model just 32 megabytes in size that can generate both speech and music, a notably compact footprint for the task.

stories.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
stories.tldr: Ramp data shows AI usage still climbing but spending levelling off, as price cuts and tighter cost control take hold just as Anthropic nears an IPO.

stories.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
stories.tldr: OpenAI has released BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark testing how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science tasks.

stories.title: Google's eyewear partners can't keep a lid on its smart glasses plans
stories.tldr: Gentle Monster, one of Google's smart glasses partners, says its Intelligent Eyewear line opens for pre-order on 12 November, another sign of Google's glasses push taking shape.

stories.title: Google's Find Hub can finally notify you if you've left a tracker behind
stories.tldr: Google's Find Hub can now warn you if you have left a Bluetooth tracker behind, rolling out a separation alert feature to help recover lost items.

stories.title: Pentagon offers battery startup 6K $250M loan to build US factory
stories.tldr: The Pentagon has conditionally approved a $250 million loan for battery startup 6K to scale up its microwave-plasma manufacturing process at a new US factory.

stories.title: Eufy's clever outdoor security camera that lives inside is now available to buy
stories.tldr: Eufy's new $80 Window Camera E10 is an outdoor security camera that sticks to the inside of a window, facing out, and is now on sale.

stories.title: iPhone Duo: The apps are coming
stories.tldr: Two weeks into using the iPhone Duo as both phone and tablet, Six Colors' Jason Snell finds developers increasingly building apps that take advantage of the split-screen form factor.

stories.title: Touch and Glow
stories.tldr: John Gruber reflects on Apple's 'Pro and Tell' event, the new PROLED XDR MacBook Pros, and what they say about the state of the Mac platform.

stories.title: watchOS 27.3 adds new Apple Watch feature that I absolutely love
stories.tldr: watchOS 27.3, out in beta this week alongside iOS 27.3, adds Siri Recap to the latest Apple Watch models, a feature 9to5Mac is already finding useful.

stories.title: Notes from Apple's Siri AI Labs: Schemas, Tools, and Skills
stories.tldr: MacStories attended Apple's online Apple Intelligence Group Lab this week, where most of the session focused on Siri's underlying schemas, tools and skills, largely mirroring Apple's own developer documentation.

stories.title: Robert Pattinson And Nicholas Hoult Round Out 'James Bond' Screen Tests
stories.tldr: Robert Pattinson and Nicholas Hoult have reportedly screen-tested for James Bond with director Denis Villeneuve, Deadline reports, though no casting has been confirmed.

stories.title: Godzilla Minus Zero's King Ghidorah Has One Scene That Was 55 Years In The Making
stories.tldr: Godzilla Minus Zero's director had one King Ghidorah scene in mind for decades; the new film finally let him realise it.

stories.title: Idris Elba To Star In & Direct Action-Comedy 'In Laws'
stories.tldr: Idris Elba is set to star in and direct the action-comedy In Laws, with sales launching ahead of the American Film Market, Deadline reports.

stories.title: 'Godzilla Minus Zero' Roars With $6.7M in Box Office Previews Ahead of Face-Off With 'Cat in the Hat'
stories.tldr: Godzilla Minus Zero took $6.7 million in US box office previews, The Hollywood Reporter says, putting it on course to lead a weekend that also includes Wild Horse Nine and Ramayana: Rise of a Legend.

stories.title: Celtics brutalize injury-riddled Hornets 119-80 for 2nd NBA Cup win
stories.tldr: Jayson Tatum scored 34 points, 24 of them before half-time, as the Celtics beat an injury-hit Hornets side 119-80 for their second NBA Cup win.

stories.title: Rob Gronkowski Induction Ceremony to be Held on Saturday, November 7
stories.tldr: Rob Gronkowski is inducted into the Patriots Hall of Fame today at 1pm at Patriot Place Plaza, with the ceremony streamed live on Patriots.com.

stories.title: Drake Maye's early-season turnaround earns him October honors
stories.tldr: Drake Maye was named AFC Offensive Player of the Month for October after leading the Patriots to a 3-1 record while completing 67.2% of his passes.

stories.title: Kimi Antonelli reveals special gifts from Ayrton Senna's family ahead of F1 Brazilian GP
stories.tldr: New F1 champion Kimi Antonelli has revealed gifts he received from Ayrton Senna's family after visiting their estate ahead of this weekend's Brazilian Grand Prix.

stories.title: Herta finally clears his last F1 superlicence hurdle
stories.tldr: Colton Herta has cleared the final hurdle for his F1 superlicence, completing a penalty-free Friday practice session for Cadillac at the Brazilian Grand Prix.

stories.title: Camara reflects on 'very special' F1 weekend debut
stories.tldr: Rafael Camara reflects on his first outing in a 2026 F1 car as he prepares for his debut Grand Prix with Haas in Brazil this weekend.

stories.title: Watch Red Sox prospect Anderson in Saturday's AFL Home Run Derby
stories.tldr: Red Sox prospect Anderson takes part in Saturday's Arizona Fall League Home Run Derby, MLB.com previews.

read.why: Apple says the iPhone Duo has already reached 100,000 optimised apps two weeks after launch, a reminder of how fast the right growth loop compounds.
read.title: Magical growth loops

listen.why: Apple's new touchscreen MacBook Pro lands this week; this decades-old interview captures a 29-year-old Jobs making the case for the personal computer as humanity's greatest tool.
listen.title: #390 Rare Steve Jobs Interview

listen.why: With OpenAI reportedly raising another $11 billion, this profile of how Zuckerberg, Palmer Luckey, Josh Kushner and Scott Wu think is a useful look at how today's AI fortunes get built.
listen.title: How Mark Zuckerberg, Palmer Luckey, Josh Kushner & Scott Wu Think | Jeremy Stern

listen.why: Ferrari's Hamilton-Leclerc fallout is still dominating F1 headlines into this weekend's Brazilian GP, making this the week for Acquired's deep dive on the team's history.
listen.title: Ferrari

finally.title: They found a chunk of Mars in the Sahara Desert
finally.tldr: A meteorite found a few years ago in Mali has been dated at more than 4.1 billion years old, with a mix of igneous minerals that tells part of Mars's early story.
